scope: generic worker-to-existing-browseruse-tab integration only; no research submission

git.ci_scope_note: All listed CI runs are for the base head and do not include the P68 working diff.

bridge.tab_binding: opaque handoff session identity matched by worker handshake; raw tab id not persisted
bridge.request_dispatch: HTTP handlers queue only; BrowserUse API calls run from bridge.runUntil inside the active persistent Node REPL call
bridge.endpoint_binding: WSL default route private gateway; RFC1918-only bind
bridge.credential_handoff: job-scoped bearer token in WSL user cache; directory 0700/file 0600; verified then removed at run end
bridge.unsupported_response_body_capture: fail-closed; BrowserUse waitForEvent supports download/filechooser only

verification.full_suite_note: Targeted regressions passed; this is not the full repository unittest suite.

implementation_discoveries.observed: BrowserUse tab.url and tab.title are asynchronous functions, not string properties.
implementation_discoveries.impact: Initial stale-module attempt failed with Invalid URL before any tab interaction; bridge now calls the public methods.

implementation_discoveries.observed: Calling BrowserUse methods from an HTTP callback outside the originating node_repl execution context returns node_repl exec context not found.
implementation_discoveries.impact: HTTP handlers now only enqueue; runUntil dispatches browser operations inside the active Node REPL call.

implementation_discoveries.observed: The actual extension waitForEvent capability supports download and filechooser, not response.
implementation_discoveries.impact: Only download is bridged; response-only artifact paths fail closed without CDP or private API fallback.

implementation_discoveries.observed: Node REPL disallows new Function code generation.
implementation_discoveries.impact: Read-only arrow callbacks are statically checked and invoked as public evaluate expressions; no dynamic Function construction is used.
